posts.author: MarkCavin
posts.content_md:
Well, I went to Chicago for RSNA and finally got the chance to make the holy pilgrimage to the Museum of Holography. It was everything I had expected, inspirational as well as motivational. The great big dinosaur skull rainbow hologram that projected out several feet left me slack jawed for what seemed an hour. It was my first time to see examples I have only read about. It is time to shine that bright light throughout the night. 

Mark

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md: Too bad you didn't look me up when you were in town! Next time, and I extend an invitation to other forum posters to check out my incredible M^3 Visual Research Lab.

posts.author: MarkCavin
posts.content_md: You know I thought about it, but didn’t want to put you out. On the upside, I live in Milwaukee (Don’t hold it against me!!) and would be much honored to meet with you sometime.
